title: Common-stage inclusion preserves the open projection factor
statement: Fix D,C,H:SixFunctorCommonStages(D,C), a finite coefficient field E and a compactified square Q [def-sf-operation-stages]. Use the canonical natural tensorator t of [def-sf-common-projection-tensor-comparison] and the factor maps and middle comparison of [def-sf-projection-mate-factors]. For every rational K on Q.X and N on Q.Y at E, the following square commutes: i_Y(openFactor_E);target = middle;openFactor_common. Here the common factor is evaluated on i_X K and i_Y N; source and target are the prescribed endpoint comparisons of [lem-sf-rational-projection-tensor-compatibility]. This is only the open factor of the argument, and makes no assertion about the other factor or invertibility of the whole projection. The canonical tensor/pullback comparisons are those of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison].

source.place: Compatibility and the common finite coefficient-field paragraph: flat extension of scalars respects the units, counits, associativity and specified projection mate.

proof.text: Use the inverse tensor/pullback square on the pair j_!K,p^*N. Tensor naturality, the open-adjunction unit equation and the pullComposition equation identify the two transposes of the inverse open projection. Apply preservation of Hom transposes, proved directly from the coefficient-adjunction counit equation, to obtain the inverse open-projection square. Conjugation by the actual open projection isomorphisms gives its forward square. These calculations are fully proved in the private helpers pull_factorization_preserved, transpose_preserved, openProjectionInverse_preserved, normalizedOpenProjection_inv and inverse_square.

Expand the factored support identification. The coefficient composition, proper identity and open identification equations, together with naturality of their natural transformations, give its coefficient square. Invert that square and use naturality in the inner tensor/pullback endpoint comparison. This is the proved helper support_identification_preserved and the support-square portion of openFactor_preserved_of_openProjection.

Normalize the recorded stage coordinates of openFactor using the actual equalities of the open, proper, pullback and tensor functors and compactSupportNormalization. Apply proper direct image to the forward open-projection square, using naturality of the direct-image coefficient comparison, and paste with the inverse support-identification square. The resulting source comparison is exactly middle and the target is exactly target. This is the proved helper openFactor_preserved_of_openProjection, instantiated with the canonical commonProjectionTensorComparison.

lean.statement:
theorem commonProjectionOpenFactor
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C) (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar)
    (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar Q.X.obj.left E)
    (N : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar Q.Y.obj.left E) :
    (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
        (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).map
        (openFactor ((H.coefficientStages E).rationalExchange Q) K N) ≫
        (target (H.commonStageComparison E) (commonProjectionTensorComparison H E)
          Q.f Q.compactification K N).hom =
        (middle (H.commonStageComparison E) (commonProjectionTensorComparison H E)
          Q K N).hom ≫
        openFactor (H.commonStageExchange Q)
          ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Q.X.obj.left) E).obj K)
          ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)
